base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: the heavy round copper front door of the lighthouse opening onto a windswept cliff-top doorstep, with the Stink-o-Meter mounted beside it. Lighting: bright, breezy daylight.
In the shot: Gary, a tiny cartoon housefly with big shiny compound eyes, smug self-satisfied angled wings, pulling a minuscule wheeled suitcase; Duggie, an enormous, lovable Golden Retriever with shining coin-gold fur smeared with bog mud and river silt, one blade of grass stuck to his head, extraordinarily long floppy ears that flap like wings, huge soulful golden-brown eyes, a giant wagging tail, and a small swarm of cartoon flies circling his head in tight synchronised formation.
Camera: Binocular point-of-view, circular vignette, zooming into the fly swarm.
Action: Through binoculars, the view zooms past the swarm to one fly — Gary — pulling a tiny wheeled suitcase and eyeing the lighthouse walls like a property developer.
Dialogue: Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, hushed, horrified, off-screen) says: "Third from the left. He has a tiny suitcase. His name is Gary. Gary is moving in."
Sound effects: binocular focus clicks, tiny suitcase wheels rattling, ambience of wind, waves, door creak.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
